title: Shattered Assumptions: When Your Worldview Breaks (Long Listen)
desc: What happens when something shakes the basic beliefs you live by, that the world is safe, fair and makes sense? A calm, sourced long listen on the assumptive world, the just-world belief, assimilation and accommodation, the myth of the five stages of grief, resilience, making meaning, posttraumatic growth and its limits, the people around us, expressive writing, when prophecy fails, the gentle illusions, rebuilding the life story, betrayal and moral injury, what helps and what does not, and when to seek professional help. It ends with a slow wind-down for sleep. Every claim comes from named studies, and the doubts are left in. This video is educational and is not medical advice.
